rules.principle: Implement a strong identity foundation — least privilege
rules.title: IAM policy uses wildcard actions
rules.description: IAM policies should not use '*' for actions. Grant only the specific permissions required.
rules.check: policy_document.Statement[].Action contains '*'
rules.fix_hint: Replace wildcard with specific actions (e.g., 's3:GetObject', 's3:PutObject')

rules.principle: Implement a strong identity foundation — least privilege
rules.title: IAM policy uses wildcard resource
rules.description: IAM policies should scope resources to specific ARNs rather than '*'.
rules.check: policy_document.Statement[].Resource == '*' AND Statement[].Effect == 'Allow'
rules.fix_hint: Scope Resource to specific ARN patterns (e.g., 'arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*')

rules.principle: Eliminate reliance on long-term static credentials
rules.title: IAM user with access keys defined
rules.description: Avoid creating IAM users with long-term access keys. Use IAM roles with temporary credentials instead.
rules.check: resource_type == 'AWS::IAM::AccessKey' exists
rules.fix_hint: Remove IAM access keys. Use IAM roles with AssumeRole for programmatic access.

rules.title: S3 bucket without server-side encryption
rules.description: All S3 buckets should have server-side encryption enabled (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).
rules.check: BucketEncryption is not defined OR ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration is missing
rules.fix_hint: Add BucketEncryption with ServerSideEncryptionByDefault using 'aws:kms' or 'AES256'

rules.title: DynamoDB table without encryption
rules.description: DynamoDB tables should use AWS-managed or customer-managed KMS keys for encryption.
rules.check: SSESpecification is not defined OR SSEEnabled == false
rules.fix_hint: Add SSESpecification with SSEEnabled: true and SSEType: 'KMS'

rules.title: EBS volume without encryption
rules.description: All EBS volumes should be encrypted at rest.
rules.check: Encrypted == false OR BlockDeviceMappings[].Ebs.Encrypted is missing/false
rules.fix_hint: Set Encrypted: true on volumes. For instances, set Encrypted: true in BlockDeviceMappings.

rules.title: RDS instance without encryption
rules.description: RDS database instances should have storage encryption enabled.
rules.check: StorageEncrypted == false OR StorageEncrypted is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Set StorageEncrypted: true. Note: requires instance recreation for existing unencrypted DBs.

rules.title: Load balancer listener using HTTP (not HTTPS)
rules.description: Application Load Balancer listeners should use HTTPS to encrypt data in transit.
rules.check: Protocol == 'HTTP' AND Port == 80 without redirect to HTTPS
rules.fix_hint: Change Protocol to HTTPS with a valid ACM certificate, or add a redirect action from HTTP to HTTPS.

rules.title: CloudFront distribution without HTTPS enforcement
rules.description: CloudFront distributions should enforce HTTPS (redirect or HTTPS-only).
rules.check: ViewerProtocolPolicy == 'allow-all'
rules.fix_hint: Set ViewerProtocolPolicy to 'redirect-to-https' or 'https-only'

rules.title: Security group allows unrestricted ingress (0.0.0.0/0)
rules.description: Security groups should not allow unrestricted inbound access on sensitive ports.
rules.check: SecurityGroupIngress[].CidrIp == '0.0.0.0/0' AND FromPort in [22, 3389, 3306, 5432, 1433, 27017]
rules.fix_hint: Restrict CidrIp to specific IP ranges or use security group references for internal traffic.

rules.title: API Gateway without WAF association
rules.description: Public-facing API Gateways should be associated with AWS WAF for DDoS and injection protection.
rules.check: No AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation referencing this API
rules.fix_hint: Create a WAFv2 WebACL and associate it with the API Gateway stage.

rules.title: S3 bucket with public access enabled
rules.description: S3 buckets should block public access unless explicitly required for static hosting.
rules.check: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration is missing OR any Block* property is false
rules.fix_hint: Add PublicAccessBlockConfiguration with all four Block properties set to true.

rules.title: CloudTrail not enabled
rules.description: All accounts should have CloudTrail enabled for API auditing.
rules.check: No AWS::CloudTrail::Trail resource in template (for account-level stacks)
rules.fix_hint: Add a CloudTrail trail with IsMultiRegionTrail: true and IsLogging: true.

rules.title: Lambda function without X-Ray tracing
rules.description: Lambda functions should enable active X-Ray tracing for distributed tracing.
rules.check: TracingConfig.Mode != 'Active' OR TracingConfig is missing
rules.fix_hint: Add TracingConfig with Mode: 'Active'

rules.title: RDS instance publicly accessible
rules.description: RDS instances should not be publicly accessible. Use private subnets and bastion hosts.
rules.check: PubliclyAccessible == true
rules.fix_hint: Set PubliclyAccessible: false and place in a private subnet.

rules.title: No auto-scaling configured for compute
rules.description: EC2 instances or ECS services should use Auto Scaling to handle demand changes.
rules.check: No associated AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup or ECS service DesiredCount is static without scaling policies
rules.fix_hint: Add an Auto Scaling group or Application Auto Scaling policy.

rules.principle: Design for failure — distributed system best practices
rules.title: Single-AZ deployment
rules.description: Production workloads should span multiple Availability Zones for fault tolerance.
rules.check: MultiAZ == false OR AvailabilityZones has only 1 entry OR Subnets reference only 1 AZ
rules.fix_hint: Enable MultiAZ for RDS. Use subnets in at least 2 AZs for ALB/ECS/ASG.

rules.principle: Design for failure — handle component failures gracefully
rules.title: SQS queue without Dead Letter Queue
rules.description: SQS queues should have a DLQ to capture messages that fail processing, preventing silent message loss.
rules.check: RedrivePolicy is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Add RedrivePolicy with deadLetterTargetArn and maxReceiveCount (recommended: 3-5).

rules.principle: Design for failure — handle component failures gracefully
rules.title: Lambda function without DLQ or on-failure destination
rules.description: Async Lambda invocations should have a DLQ or on-failure destination to capture failed events.
rules.check: DeadLetterConfig is not defined AND no EventInvokeConfig with OnFailure destination
rules.fix_hint: Add DeadLetterConfig with TargetArn (SQS or SNS) or configure EventInvokeConfig OnFailure.

rules.principle: Design for failure — withstand component failures
rules.title: RDS without automated backups
rules.description: RDS instances should have automated backups enabled with appropriate retention period.
rules.check: BackupRetentionPeriod == 0 OR BackupRetentionPeriod is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Set BackupRetentionPeriod to at least 7 (days). Consider 14-35 for production.

rules.title: DynamoDB table without Point-in-Time Recovery
rules.description: DynamoDB tables should enable PITR for continuous backup and point-in-time restore.
rules.check: PointInTimeRecoverySpecification.PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled != true
rules.fix_hint: Add PointInTimeRecoverySpecification with PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

rules.title: S3 bucket without versioning
rules.description: S3 buckets storing important data should enable versioning for accidental deletion protection.
rules.check: VersioningConfiguration.Status != 'Enabled'
rules.fix_hint: Add VersioningConfiguration with Status: 'Enabled'

rules.principle: Monitor workload resources — detect issues early
rules.title: No CloudWatch alarms for critical resources
rules.description: Critical resources (ALBs, RDS, Lambda, SQS) should have CloudWatch alarms for key metrics.
rules.check: No AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm references this resource
rules.fix_hint: Add CloudWatch alarms for key metrics: ALB (5xx errors, latency), RDS (CPU, connections), Lambda (errors, duration), SQS (ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage).

rules.title: Lambda function without reserved concurrency
rules.description: Lambda functions serving critical paths should set reserved concurrency to prevent throttling from other functions.
rules.check: ReservedConcurrentExecutions is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Set ReservedConcurrentExecutions based on expected peak traffic. This guarantees capacity for critical functions.

rules.title: API Gateway without throttling configured
rules.description: API Gateway should have throttling limits to protect downstream services from overload.
rules.check: MethodSettings[].ThrottlingRateLimit is not defined AND no UsagePlan associated
rules.fix_hint: Configure ThrottlingRateLimit and ThrottlingBurstLimit in stage method settings or via a UsagePlan.

rules.title: Lambda event source without bisect-on-error
rules.description: Lambda event source mappings for streams (Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams) should enable BisectBatchOnFunctionError to isolate poison messages.
rules.check: EventSourceArn references Kinesis/DynamoDB stream AND BisectBatchOnFunctionError != true
rules.fix_hint: Set BisectBatchOnFunctionError: true and configure MaximumRetryAttempts with a DestinationConfig.OnFailure.

rules.principle: Select the best compute option for your workload
rules.title: Lambda using x86_64 architecture (Graviton available)
rules.description: Lambda functions should consider arm64 (Graviton2) for up to 34% better price-performance.
rules.check: Architectures is not defined OR Architectures == ['x86_64']
rules.fix_hint: Set Architectures: ['arm64'] unless you have native x86 dependencies. Test compatibility first.

rules.title: Lambda memory set to default 128MB
rules.description: Lambda's default 128MB is often insufficient and causes slow execution. Right-size using AWS Lambda Power Tuning.
rules.check: MemorySize == 128 OR MemorySize is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Run AWS Lambda Power Tuning to find optimal memory. Most functions perform better at 256-1024MB.

rules.principle: Use managed services to reduce operational burden
rules.title: EC2 instance without current-generation type
rules.description: Use current-generation instance types for better price-performance (e.g., m6i, c6g, r6g).
rules.check: InstanceType starts with m4, m3, c4, c3, r4, r3, t2
rules.fix_hint: Upgrade to current-gen instances: m4→m6i, c4→c6i, r4→r6i, t2→t3. Consider Graviton (m6g, c6g) for arm64.

rules.title: EBS volume using gp2 (gp3 available)
rules.description: gp3 volumes provide better baseline performance than gp2 at lower cost. Migrate unless burst credits are needed.
rules.check: VolumeType == 'gp2'
rules.fix_hint: Change VolumeType to 'gp3'. gp3 provides 3000 IOPS baseline (vs gp2's 100-3000 based on size) at 20% lower cost.

rules.title: DynamoDB table without DAX or caching layer
rules.description: Read-heavy DynamoDB tables should consider DAX or ElastiCache for microsecond response times.
rules.check: No associated AWS::DAX::Cluster AND table appears in read-heavy patterns
rules.fix_hint: Add DAX cluster for DynamoDB-native caching, or ElastiCache (Redis) for custom caching patterns.

rules.title: S3 static website without CloudFront
rules.description: S3 buckets serving static content should use CloudFront for global edge caching and lower latency.
rules.check: WebsiteConfiguration is defined BUT no CloudFront distribution references this bucket as origin
rules.fix_hint: Add a CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as origin. Use OAI/OAC for secure access.

rules.principle: Use managed services — reduce undifferentiated heavy lifting
rules.title: Lambda function with VPC and no NAT Gateway
rules.description: Lambda in VPC without NAT Gateway cannot access internet services (APIs, SaaS), causing timeouts.
rules.check: VpcConfig is defined AND subnet is private AND no NAT Gateway in route table
rules.fix_hint: Add a NAT Gateway in a public subnet, or use VPC endpoints for AWS services. Consider removing VPC if internet access is needed but VPC isn't required.

rules.title: Lambda timeout set to maximum (900s)
rules.description: Lambda timeout at max (15min) often indicates the function is doing too much. Consider Step Functions.
rules.check: Timeout == 900
rules.fix_hint: Break long-running tasks into smaller functions orchestrated by Step Functions. Set timeout to expected duration + buffer.

rules.title: Resource without cost allocation tags
rules.description: All resources should have tags for cost tracking (e.g., Environment, Team, Project, CostCenter).
rules.check: Tags is not defined OR Tags does not include one of: Environment, Team, Project, CostCenter
rules.fix_hint: Add Tags with at least: Environment (dev/staging/prod), Team, and Project/CostCenter.

rules.principle: Select the correct resource type and size
rules.title: Over-provisioned DynamoDB with provisioned capacity
rules.description: DynamoDB tables with low or unpredictable traffic should use On-Demand billing mode to avoid paying for unused capacity.
rules.check: BillingMode == 'PROVISIONED' (consider if workload is unpredictable)
rules.fix_hint: Use BillingMode: 'PAY_PER_REQUEST' for unpredictable workloads. Use Provisioned + Auto Scaling for steady workloads.

rules.title: NAT Gateway used for S3/DynamoDB traffic
rules.description: S3 and DynamoDB traffic through NAT Gateway incurs data processing charges. Use VPC Gateway Endpoints (free).
rules.check: NAT Gateway exists AND no S3/DynamoDB VPC Gateway Endpoint defined
rules.fix_hint: Add VPC Gateway Endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint with ServiceName: 'com.amazonaws.{region}.s3' and 'com.amazonaws.{region}.dynamodb'.

rules.title: ECS service with static desired count (no scaling)
rules.description: ECS services with fixed task counts pay for capacity during low-traffic periods.
rules.check: DesiredCount is static AND no AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget defined
rules.fix_hint: Add Application Auto Scaling with Target Tracking on CPU/memory or ALB request count per target.

rules.title: CloudWatch Logs without retention policy
rules.description: CloudWatch Log Groups without a retention policy retain logs forever, accumulating costs.
rules.check: RetentionInDays is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Set RetentionInDays (e.g., 30 for dev, 90 for staging, 365 for prod). Archive to S3 for long-term needs.

rules.title: S3 bucket without lifecycle rules
rules.description: S3 buckets should have lifecycle rules to transition objects to cheaper storage classes or expire old data.
rules.check: LifecycleConfiguration is not defined
rules.fix_hint: Add LifecycleConfiguration rules: transition to IA after 30 days, Glacier after 90 days, expire after 365 days (adjust for use case).

rules.principle: Use managed services to reduce cost of ownership
rules.title: Self-managed Elasticsearch on EC2
rules.description: Self-managed Elasticsearch on EC2 has high operational overhead. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service.
rules.check: UserData or metadata contains elasticsearch/opensearch installation
rules.fix_hint: Migrate to AWS::OpenSearchService::Domain for managed scaling, patching, and backups.

rules.title: No budget or billing alarm defined
rules.description: Stacks should include billing alarms or AWS Budgets to detect unexpected cost spikes.
rules.check: No AWS::Budgets::Budget resource in account-level templates
rules.fix_hint: Add AWS::Budgets::Budget with threshold notifications at 50%, 80%, 100% of expected monthly spend.

rules.principle: Use Infrastructure as Code — version control
rules.title: Lambda function with inline code
rules.description: Lambda functions should use packaged code (S3 or container image) rather than inline code for versioning and testing.
rules.check: Code.ZipFile is defined (inline code) instead of Code.S3Bucket/S3Key or Code.ImageUri
rules.fix_hint: Package Lambda code as a zip in S3 or container image. Use Code.S3Bucket/S3Key or ImageUri.

rules.title: Lambda function without structured logging
rules.description: Lambda functions should use structured (JSON) logging for easier searching and analysis in CloudWatch Insights.
rules.check: LoggingConfig.LogFormat != 'JSON' OR LoggingConfig is missing
rules.fix_hint: Add LoggingConfig with LogFormat: 'JSON' and ApplicationLogLevel: 'INFO' (available in Lambda runtime).

rules.title: No CloudWatch Dashboard defined
rules.description: Production workloads should have a CloudWatch Dashboard for operational visibility.
rules.check: No AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard resource in production stacks
rules.fix_hint: Add a CloudWatch Dashboard with widgets for key metrics: errors, latency, throughput, resource utilization.

rules.title: Lambda without version/alias (no safe deployment)
rules.description: Lambda functions should use aliases and versions for safe deployments with traffic shifting.
rules.check: No AWS::Lambda::Alias or AWS::Lambda::Version defined for this function
rules.fix_hint: Add Lambda Alias + Version with AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup for canary/linear deployment.

rules.title: Step Functions state machine without error handling
rules.description: Step Functions should have Catch/Retry blocks on task states to handle transient failures gracefully.
rules.check: Definition.States[].Type == 'Task' AND no Catch or Retry defined
rules.fix_hint: Add Retry (for transient errors) and Catch (for permanent failures) on all Task states.

rules.title: No CI/CD pipeline defined
rules.description: Workloads should have automated deployment pipelines for consistent, repeatable deployments.
rules.check: No AWS::CodePipeline::Pipeline or equivalent CI/CD resource in template
rules.fix_hint: Add AWS::CodePipeline::Pipeline with Source, Build, and Deploy stages. Use CodeBuild for build step.

rules.title: Resources without consistent naming convention
rules.description: Resources should follow a consistent naming pattern for identification (e.g., {env}-{service}-{resource}).
rules.check: Resource logical IDs or Name properties don't follow a consistent pattern
rules.fix_hint: Use naming convention: {environment}-{service}-{resource-type} (e.g., prod-orderapi-queue).

rules.title: EC2/ECS using x86 when Graviton is available
rules.description: Graviton (arm64) instances offer better energy efficiency and price-performance.
rules.check: InstanceType is not *g* family (m6g, c6g, r6g, t4g) OR RuntimePlatform.CpuArchitecture != 'ARM64'
rules.fix_hint: Switch to Graviton instances (m6g, c6g, r6g, t4g). Up to 40% better price-performance and lower energy consumption.

rules.title: Always-on compute for sporadic workloads
rules.description: EC2 instances running 24/7 for sporadic workloads waste energy. Use serverless or auto-scaling.
rules.check: Standalone EC2 instance without Auto Scaling Group AND no schedule-based scaling
rules.fix_hint: Consider Lambda for event-driven work, Fargate for containers, or EC2 Auto Scaling with scale-to-zero.

rules.title: Cross-region data transfer without justification
rules.description: Cross-region replication/transfer consumes energy and bandwidth. Use only when needed for DR/compliance.
rules.check: ReplicationConfiguration references a different region OR GlobalTable has replicas
rules.fix_hint: Verify cross-region replication is needed (DR, latency, compliance). Remove if only for convenience.

rules.title: No data lifecycle management
rules.description: Data should be tiered and expired to reduce storage energy consumption.
rules.check: S3: no LifecycleConfiguration. DynamoDB: no TTL configured.
rules.fix_hint: S3: add lifecycle rules. DynamoDB: enable TimeToLiveSpecification for auto-expiry of old records.

rules.principle: Protect data at rest — KMS key rotation
rules.title: KMS key without automatic rotation
rules.description: Customer-managed KMS keys should have automatic key rotation enabled.
rules.check: EnableKeyRotation != true
rules.fix_hint: Set EnableKeyRotation: true

rules.title: Lambda function in VPC without security group least privilege
rules.description: Lambda security groups should restrict outbound traffic to only required destinations.
rules.check: VpcConfig.SecurityGroupIds reference SGs with unrestricted egress (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports)
rules.fix_hint: Restrict security group egress to specific CIDR ranges and ports required by the function.

rules.title: No health check configured for load balancer targets
rules.description: Load balancer target groups must have health checks to detect and route around unhealthy targets.
rules.check: HealthCheckEnabled == false OR HealthCheckPath is not defined (for HTTP/HTTPS)
rules.fix_hint: Configure HealthCheckPath (e.g., '/health'), HealthCheckIntervalSeconds, and HealthyThresholdCount.

rules.title: Synchronous Lambda-to-Lambda invocation
rules.description: Direct synchronous Lambda-to-Lambda calls create tight coupling. Use async patterns (SQS, SNS, EventBridge).
rules.check: Lambda IAM policy allows lambda:InvokeFunction on another Lambda (synchronous pattern)
rules.fix_hint: Replace direct invocation with SQS queue, SNS topic, or EventBridge rule between functions.

rules.title: VPC with single NAT Gateway (single AZ)
rules.description: A single NAT Gateway creates a single point of failure. Use one NAT Gateway per AZ.
rules.check: Only 1 NAT Gateway defined for a multi-AZ VPC
rules.fix_hint: Deploy one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone with separate route tables per private subnet.

rules.title: API Gateway without connection reuse to backend
rules.description: API Gateway HTTP integrations should enable connection reuse (keep-alive) to reduce latency.
rules.check: ConnectionType is not 'VPC_LINK' for private integrations (connection pooling)
rules.fix_hint: Use VPC Link for private integrations. For HTTP backends, ensure keep-alive headers are passed.

rules.principle: Use managed services — optimize cold starts
rules.title: Lambda function with large package and no provisioned concurrency
rules.description: Large Lambda packages (>50MB) or VPC-attached functions may have cold start issues. Consider provisioned concurrency for latency-sensitive paths.
rules.check: VpcConfig is defined OR Code references large package AND no ProvisionedConcurrencyConfig
rules.fix_hint: Add AWS::Lambda::ProvisionedConcurrencyConfig for latency-sensitive functions, or reduce package size with layers.

rules.title: RDS using commercial engine when open-source works
rules.description: Consider Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL compatible) or open-source engines to reduce licensing costs.
rules.check: Engine is 'oracle-*' or 'sqlserver-*'
rules.fix_hint: Evaluate migration to Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL compatible) for up to 90% cost reduction vs commercial engines.

rules.title: Provisioned IOPS (io1/io2) EBS without high I/O need
rules.description: Provisioned IOPS volumes are expensive. Use gp3 with custom IOPS unless sustained high IOPS is required.
rules.check: VolumeType in ['io1', 'io2'] (verify if workload actually needs >16000 IOPS)
rules.fix_hint: gp3 supports up to 16000 IOPS. Only use io1/io2 if you need >16000 or sub-ms latency guarantees.

rules.title: Lambda function without runtime update strategy
rules.description: Lambda functions should use supported runtimes and have a plan for runtime updates.
rules.check: Runtime is deprecated (python3.7, python3.8, nodejs14.x, nodejs16.x, java8, dotnetcore3.1)
rules.fix_hint: Upgrade to current runtime: python3.12+, nodejs20.x+, java21+, dotnet8. Enable auto-upgrade with RuntimeManagementConfig.

rules.title: Single IAM role shared across all Lambda functions
rules.description: Each Lambda function should have its own execution role with only the permissions it needs.
rules.check: Multiple Lambda functions reference the same Role
rules.fix_hint: Create a dedicated IAM role per function with only the required permissions for that function.

rules.title: Hardcoded secrets in template
rules.description: Never hardcode secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens) in IaC templates. Use Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store.
rules.check: Template contains strings matching patterns: password, secret, api_key, token with literal values (not !Ref or !Sub to SecretManager)
rules.fix_hint: Use AWS::SecretsManager::Secret or AWS::SSM::Parameter (SecureString) and reference via dynamic references: {{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}

rules.principle: Use deployment strategies that limit blast radius
rules.title: ECS service without deployment circuit breaker
rules.description: ECS services should enable deployment circuit breaker to auto-rollback failed deployments.
rules.check: DeploymentConfiguration.DeploymentCircuitBreaker is not defined OR Enable != true
rules.fix_hint: Add DeploymentCircuitBreaker with Enable: true and Rollback: true under DeploymentConfiguration.

rules.title: Stack without description or metadata
rules.description: CloudFormation stacks should include a Description and Metadata for discoverability.
rules.check: Template Description is empty or missing
rules.fix_hint: Add a Description at the template top level explaining the stack's purpose, owner, and environment.

rules.title: SNS topic without subscription (orphan notification path)
rules.description: SNS topics without subscriptions mean alerts/notifications go nowhere.
rules.check: No AWS::SNS::Subscription references this topic
rules.fix_hint: Add at least one subscription (email, Lambda, SQS) to ensure notifications are delivered.

rules.title: Self-managed Kubernetes on EC2
rules.description: Self-managed K8s on EC2 has high operational overhead. Consider EKS or Fargate.
rules.check: UserData contains kubeadm, kubelet, or kubernetes installation
rules.fix_hint: Migrate to Amazon EKS for managed control plane. Use Fargate for serverless pods where applicable.

rules.title: Fixed-size Auto Scaling Group (min == max)
rules.description: Auto Scaling Groups with MinSize == MaxSize never scale, paying for peak capacity at all times.
rules.check: MinSize == MaxSize AND MaxSize > 1
rules.fix_hint: Set MinSize lower than MaxSize to allow scaling. Add scaling policies based on CPU, requests, or schedule.

rules.title: VPC without Flow Logs enabled
rules.description: VPC Flow Logs should be enabled for network traffic monitoring and forensics.
rules.check: No AWS::EC2::FlowLog resource associated with this VPC
rules.fix_hint: Add AWS::EC2::FlowLog with TrafficType: 'ALL' and destination (CloudWatch Logs or S3).

rules.title: Lambda execution role with AdministratorAccess
rules.description: Lambda roles should never have AdministratorAccess or PowerUserAccess managed policies.
rules.check: ManagedPolicyArns contains 'AdministratorAccess' or 'PowerUserAccess' AND role is assumed by Lambda
rules.fix_hint: Replace with specific IAM policies granting only required actions on specific resources.

rules.title: RDS without deletion protection
rules.description: Production RDS instances should have deletion protection to prevent accidental deletion.
rules.check: DeletionProtection != true
rules.fix_hint: Set DeletionProtection: true for production databases.

rules.title: Lambda function without timeout configured
rules.description: Lambda functions without explicit timeout default to 3 seconds, which may cause unexpected timeouts.
rules.check: Timeout is not defined (defaults to 3s)
rules.fix_hint: Set explicit Timeout based on expected execution time + buffer. Typically 10-30s for API handlers, 60-300s for async processing.

rules.principle: Select the purpose-built database for your access pattern
rules.title: RDS for simple key-value lookups
rules.description: If the workload is primarily key-value lookups (by ID), DynamoDB offers single-digit ms latency at any scale.
rules.check: Semantic analysis: table appears to be key-value (single PK lookup pattern)
rules.fix_hint: Consider DynamoDB for key-value access patterns. Reserve RDS for complex queries, joins, and transactions.

rules.title: Lambda function with excessive timeout and memory
rules.description: Over-provisioned Lambda (high memory + long timeout) reserves more resources than needed, wasting energy.
rules.check: MemorySize > 1024 AND Timeout > 300 (potential over-provisioning)
rules.fix_hint: Right-size with Lambda Power Tuning. If high memory is needed for speed but timeout is long, verify the function actually uses both.

rules.title: Multi-region active-active without business justification
rules.description: Multi-region active-active doubles resource consumption. Use active-passive unless strict RPO/RTO requires it.
rules.check: Global table with multiple regions AND no clear latency/compliance requirement
rules.fix_hint: Evaluate if active-passive (pilot light / warm standby) meets RPO/RTO requirements at lower environmental cost.

rules.title: API Gateway without access logging
rules.description: API Gateway should have access logging enabled for security monitoring and auditing.
rules.check: AccessLogSetting is not defined OR DestinationArn is missing
rules.fix_hint: Add AccessLogSetting with a CloudWatch Log Group ARN and a structured log format.

rules.principle: Protect data in transit — internal encryption
rules.title: RDS without TLS enforcement
rules.description: RDS connections should enforce TLS to encrypt data in transit between application and database.
rules.check: No parameter group with rds.force_ssl = 1 (PostgreSQL) or require_secure_transport = ON (MySQL)
rules.fix_hint: Create a parameter group with TLS enforcement enabled and associate with the instance.

rules.title: SQS consumer without idempotency handling
rules.description: SQS provides at-least-once delivery. Consumers must handle duplicate messages (idempotency).
rules.check: EventSourceArn references SQS (semantic: consumer writes to DB without deduplication logic)
rules.fix_hint: Implement idempotency: use DynamoDB conditional writes, or maintain a processed-message-ID table with TTL.

rules.title: Hardcoded configuration values in template
rules.description: Use CloudFormation Parameters or SSM Parameter Store for environment-specific values.
rules.check: Properties contain hardcoded values that should vary by environment (URLs, ARNs, account IDs)
rules.fix_hint: Use Parameters with Conditions for env-specific values, or SSM dynamic references: {{resolve:ssm:...}}

rules.title: ALB in public subnet targeting private instances
rules.description: Ensure ALB → target communication uses private IPs to avoid data transfer charges.
rules.check: TargetType == 'ip' AND targets use public IPs when private would work
rules.fix_hint: Use private subnet IPs as targets. Ensure ALB and targets are in the same VPC.

rules.title: ECS task definition running as root
rules.description: ECS containers should not run as root. Use a non-root user for defense in depth.
rules.check: ContainerDefinitions[].User is not defined (defaults to root) OR User == 'root' OR User == '0'
rules.fix_hint: Set User: '1000' (or any non-root UID) in container definition. Ensure image supports non-root.

rules.title: ECS task with elevated privileges
rules.description: ECS containers should not use privileged mode or excessive Linux capabilities.
rules.check: ContainerDefinitions[].Privileged == true OR LinuxParameters.Capabilities.Add contains 'ALL'
rules.fix_hint: Set Privileged: false. Drop all capabilities and add only what's needed: LinuxParameters.Capabilities.Drop: ['ALL'].

rules.title: All Lambda functions sharing unreserved concurrency pool
rules.description: Without reserved concurrency, one function's spike can throttle all other functions in the account.
rules.check: Multiple functions AND none have ReservedConcurrentExecutions defined
rules.fix_hint: Set ReservedConcurrentExecutions on critical functions to guarantee capacity. Leave non-critical functions on shared pool.

rules.title: Lambda accessing DynamoDB without VPC endpoint
rules.description: Lambda in VPC accessing DynamoDB traverses NAT Gateway (adds latency + cost). Use a VPC endpoint.
rules.check: Lambda in VPC AND IAM policy allows dynamodb:* AND no DynamoDB VPC Gateway Endpoint exists
rules.fix_hint: Add VPC Gateway Endpoint for DynamoDB: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint with ServiceName 'com.amazonaws.{region}.dynamodb'.

rules.title: Non-critical batch workload on On-Demand instances
rules.description: Batch processing, CI/CD, and fault-tolerant workloads should use Spot instances for up to 90% savings.
rules.check: MixedInstancesPolicy.InstancesDistribution.SpotAllocationStrategy is not defined for batch/non-critical ASGs
rules.fix_hint: Add MixedInstancesPolicy with SpotAllocationStrategy: 'capacity-optimized' and OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity: 0-20.

rules.title: No feature flag mechanism for new deployments
rules.description: New features should be behind feature flags for safe rollout and instant rollback without redeployment.
rules.check: No AWS::AppConfig resources in template (for feature flags / configuration management)
rules.fix_hint: Add AWS AppConfig for feature flags: Application + Environment + ConfigurationProfile + DeploymentStrategy.

rules.title: Cross-account access without external ID
rules.description: IAM roles allowing cross-account access should require an ExternalId to prevent confused deputy attacks.
rules.check: AssumeRolePolicyDocument allows Principal from another account AND Condition.StringEquals.sts:ExternalId is missing
rules.fix_hint: Add Condition: StringEquals: sts:ExternalId: '<unique-external-id>' to the trust policy.
